definitions.short: Eliphelet or Elpelet , the name of six Israelites
definitions.full: H467. Eliphelet אֱלִיפֶ֫לֶט ( פָֿ֑לֶט 2Sam 5:16 +) proper name, masculine ( God is deliverance , compare מַּלְטִיאֵל ) a. son of David 2Sam 5:16 ; 1Chr 3:6 , 8 ; 14:7 ; = אֶלְמָּ֑לֶט 14:5 . b. one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:34 (compare also אֱלִיפָל 1Chr 11:35 ). c. a Benjamite 1Chr 8:39 . d. one of the line of Adonikam Ezra 8:13 . e. of the line of Hashum Ezra 10:33 .
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֱלְפֶּלֶט ; from 410 and 6405 ; God of deliverance;

occurrences.englishText: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last; and these are their names: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.
Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
